name: Input
intent: Single-line text entry with its own label, hint, error and character count. The label sits on top, at the start, or is hidden.
usage: Use Input for short text: names, emails, amounts, search. It is one component: pass label, hint and error as props, no Field wrapper. Always pass label; set hideLabel when the screen already makes the purpose clear, like a search box. required adds a red asterisk and the native required attribute. error shows a red border and a message under the field; invalid shows the red border alone. prefix and suffix are text inside the field, like https:// or USD. maxLength adds a live counter. type="file" opens the native file picker; accept limits the file types and multiple allows more than one. See contracts/input.json for the full contract.

label.note: Always set. With hideLabel it stays for screen readers only.

hideLabel.note: No visible label. Use when the purpose is clear from the screen, like search.

labelPosition.note: start puts the label in a 160px right-aligned column beside the field, for dense forms.

type.note: file opens the native file picker. value, defaultValue, placeholder, prefix, suffix and maxLength do not apply to it.

placeholder.note: An example value. Never the only label.

accept.note: type="file" only. File types to offer, like image/* or .pdf,.png.

multiple.note: type="file" only. Pick more than one file.

onFilesChange.note: type="file" only. (files: File[]) => void. Runs with the chosen files.

required.note: Red asterisk before the label and the native required attribute.

invalid.note: Red border without a message. Prefer error so people know what to fix.

error.note: Message under the field. Also turns the border red. Replaces hint.

help.note: Shows a help icon beside the label. The text opens in a Tooltip once the kit has one; until then screen readers get it with the field.

prefix.note: Text inside the field before the value, like https:// or $.

suffix.note: Text inside the field after the value, like .com or USD.

iconStart.note: Material Symbols name before the value, like search. Decorative.

iconEnd.note: Material Symbols name after the value. Decorative.

maxLength.note: Limits the length and shows a count like 5/10 inside the field.

useWhen: Short text in a form: name, email, phone, amount.
A search box above a table or list.
A value with a fixed prefix or suffix, like a URL or a currency.
doNot: Do not invent a local Field, FieldLabel, FieldDescription, FieldError, FormItem, InputGroup or SearchInput.
Do not build a local tooltip for help. Pass help; the kit Tooltip will show it.
Do not use a placeholder as the label. Pass label, and hideLabel if it must not show.
Do not use for long text. Use Textarea.
Do not use for picking from fixed options. Use RadioGroup, or Select when it exists.
Do not put the error only in the placeholder or only in color. Use error.
Do not build a local FileInput, upload button or hidden <input type="file">. Use Input type="file".
a11y: A real label is tied to the input by id, visible or visually hidden with hideLabel.
hint, error and the counter are linked with aria-describedby.
error and invalid set aria-invalid. required sets the native required attribute; the asterisk is hidden from screen readers.
Focus shows a 2px brand ring around the field; red when invalid.
The help icon is a button named About {label}; its text is linked to the button and the input with aria-describedby.
Icons are decorative. Prefix and suffix are plain text next to the value.
type="file" keeps the native picker: Space or Enter opens it, and the chosen file names are read with the label.
snippet: <Input label="Email" type="email" required placeholder="you@example.com" hint="We never share your email." />
